name: io.github.tobee89/mcp-paperless-ngx
title: Paperless-ngx
description: MCP server for Paperless-ngx 3.x — full REST API coverage, schema-aware, token-frugal.

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Paperless-ngx instance

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL used when building links, if the instance is reachable under a different name from outside

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Expose only tools that cannot change anything

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Extra request headers; needed behind forward-auth proxies such as Authentik

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_MAX_PAGE_SIZE
environmentVariables.description: Hard ceiling on list page sizes

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_API_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: REST API version sent in the Accept header
